Pricing model notes

Per-seat pricing stays for teams under fifty people. Above that, Fabrikam offers a site licence priced by the number of active stores, reviewed every quarter with the customer's finance lead.

Discounts need a sign-off from Omar Reyes when they go beyond fifteen percent of the list price.
